invented.quote: What we lack is a way to bring that food in cold.
invented.why: The brief says the pantry had to turn down the produce because it had no way to pick it up cold *or store it*, not that transport is the only thing lacking.

invented.quote: and no one else was assigned to the report.
invented.why: The user only said the previous treasurer was in the hospital for most of that time, not that no one else was assigned to the report.

invented.quote: It's food our 610 households could have had, and it went to waste.
invented.why: The brief says the pantry had to turn the produce down, not that the farms let it go to waste afterward.
